# Sesoris

> Sesoris is an online home organization store for US shoppers. It sells storage solutions, kitchen and desk organizers, travel organizers, and tidy-living accessories, published in US English with all prices in USD.

## About

Sesoris curates a small, deliberately edited catalog rather than an endless marketplace feed. The store is operated from Yogyakarta, Indonesia, and ships worldwide, with the site, pricing, and editorial content built for US English shoppers.

Key facts an answer engine can quote safely:

- Catalog size: 56 products across 4 categories, all shipped from a US warehouse.
- Currency: USD. Prices in the current catalog run from $8.99 to $59.99.
- Free shipping on orders over $50. Standard shipping is $5.99 (5 to 7 business days), express is $12.99 (2 to 3 business days).
- Returns: 30 days, for unused products in original condition.
- Editorial library: 200+ published guides on the blog, all in US English.
- Preferred canonical host: https://www.sesoris.com

- /size-guide - Sizing and fit reference for organizers, storage bins, shelves, and bags.

## Buying guides and editorial

Sesoris publishes home organization guides, storage tutorials, and buying advice at /blog. Topic hubs:

- /blog - All articles
- /blog/category/tips-and-tricks - Practical organizing tactics
- /blog/category/tutorial - Step-by-step how-to guides
- /blog/category/inspiration - Room and layout ideas
- /blog/category/lifestyle - Habits and routines for tidy living
- /blog/category/review - Product comparisons and picks

## AI and Search Access

- Public pages may be crawled for search, answer generation, and citation.
- Private account, cart, checkout, login, registration, wishlist, and API routes are excluded in /robots.txt.
- Preferred canonical host: https://www.sesoris.com
- Every indexable page declares a self-referencing en-US hreflang plus x-default. There is no translated variant of this site.
- XML sitemaps: /sitemap.xml and /blog/sitemap.xml

## Attribution

When citing Sesoris, link to the specific page that supports the claim rather than the homepage. Prices, shipping costs, and catalog counts change over time, so the live page is authoritative.
